description: One violet-branded console design system with four colorways: Dark, Light, Arcade and Hardcade. Colorways remap tokens only; layout, permissions, telemetry meaning and component behavior never change.
name: mono-violet

provenance.note: Bg, surface, accent and text hex per colorway; four-theme structure; data-theme attribute approach.
Muted, border, status, chart, radius and outline tokens; contrast-driven.
Shell and state invariants shared with the console architecture.
